meta.title: Vendor Clone: refused for a user without the Procurement Manager role
gaps: Sign in as the specified non-Procurement Manager and Procurement Manager personas in the same tenant
Verify or select the tenant's Growth plan because no plan-tier step is available
Actually carry out the Vendor Clone action because no clone execution step exists
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as the specified non-Procurement Manager and Procurement Manager personas in the same tenant; Verify or select the tenant's Growth plan because no plan-tier step is available; Actually carry out the Vendor Clone action because no clone execution step exists

steps.note: Open an existing active event so its project actions can be inspected.
Assert that the current user's event menu does not offer the Vendor Clone action.

args.need: sign in as a Procurement Manager in the same tenant and verify that the active event's Clone Project action is available

steps.note: A second role session is required to compare the Procurement Manager's permission.
Assert that the Procurement Manager's event menu offers an enabled Clone Project action after the tester switches roles.
